clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Serge Hinott brews mixtures for the Forsaken war effort. The Forsaken alchemist works alongside Apothecary Lydon, preparing concoctions, antidotes, and reagents for the Royal Apothecary Society.

Serge Hinott brews remedies and other mixtures for the Forsaken in Tarren Mill. He works beside Apothecary Lydon, whose work includes chemical development and plague research against nearby human settlements such as Southshore. Hinott handles specialized brewing, including restorative salves and antidotes for field agents and scouts who face poisons or other toxic mishaps.
